proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: universal openness of schemes over a field gives G_K -> G open; every point of T x_k U comes from a K-point (t, u), and the image of (T x_k U)_K -> G_K contains the translate t . U_K which is open; hence the image contains an open neighbourhood of every point of it (source lines 971-980)
